heading: About Me
biography: I am a Full-Stack Web Developer with a multidisciplinary foundation bridging civil engineering rigor, web technologies, and entrepreneurial execution. Having graduated with a B.Sc. in Civil Engineering from the University of Asia Pacific (UAP), I developed strong analytical problem-solving abilities, structural thinking, and attention to detail—qualities that directly shape how I architect web software today.

My journey in digital technology started with training in SEO and affiliate marketing in 2015, which gave me an early appreciation for search performance, user intent, and product discoverability. I subsequently pursued intensive web development training through Programming Hero (covering JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB) and advanced PHP/Laravel development through BITM.

As a co-founder of two business initiatives—iLabs360 (Technology and Software Solutions) and Shopnoneer (Real Estate and Property Services)—I have gained practical commercial awareness. I focus on developing clean, maintainable, and responsive web applications that solve real-world problems efficiently.
careerGoals: To design and implement robust, performant web applications that deliver measurable value, while continually expanding my technical depth across modern software engineering stacks.
